entries.2d955c6faa5447f6: This business manufactures and sells press combined processing systems and digital servo presses, provides contract processing of press parts, and manufactures and sells chrome-free paints. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,039 million, down 16.1% from the previous year. It handles the direct-acting digital servo presses “ZENFormer” and “ZENFormer nano,” which incorporate proprietary control technology, and “Divo,” which has a split-station structure. The company carries this out at its Yamato site and others.

entries.4d8ccaa7c17cfe0c: This business provides contract processing of aircraft engine parts, gas turbine parts and other various metal products, and contract surface treatment of aircraft engine parts and gas turbine parts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥9,906 million, up 18.8% from the previous year. Increased demand for aircraft, growth in demand for defense equipment, and higher orders for gas turbine parts linked to rising electricity demand contributed to this. The company carries this out at its sites in Okayama, Narita, Kasugai, Komaki and others.
entries.77caffebb8cbb024: Contract surface treatment that applies heat- and corrosion-resistant coatings and surface hardening film treatments to aircraft engine parts and gas turbine parts. It uses licensed technology introduced from the United States.

In addition to the company, the consolidated subsidiary KYODO DIE-WORKS (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. is responsible for manufacturing aluminum extrusion dies in Thailand.
